# Global flags

Every relgap command accepts these flags, before or after the command name. `-h, --help` prints the help of any command.

| Flag | Description | Type | Default | Values | Config key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--color` | colorize output: auto, always or never | string | `auto` | `auto`: color on a terminal unless NO\_COLOR is set<br>`always`: always color<br>`never`: never color |  |  |
| `--concurrency` | GitHub requests in flight at once, 2 at most without a token (config github.concurrency) | int | `8` |  | [`github.concurrency`](/reference/config#github-concurrency) |  |
| `--config` | config file to use instead of the discovered .relgap.yaml (env RELGAP\_CONFIG) | string |  |  |  |  |
| `--format` | output format: tty, plain, md, json, sarif or github (default tty when stdout is a terminal, else plain) | string |  | `tty`: table with color for a terminal<br>`plain`: table without color<br>`md`: Markdown<br>`json`: JSON envelope for scripts<br>`sarif`: SARIF 2.1.0 for code scanning<br>`github`: GitHub Actions annotations |  |  |
| `--log-file` | write logs to this file instead of stderr | string |  |  |  |  |
| `--log-format` | log format: text or json | string | `text` | `text`: human-readable lines<br>`json`: one JSON object per line |  |  |
| `--min-confidence` | hide entries below this confidence, 0..1 (config policy.min\_confidence) | number | `0.5` | `0`: show every entry<br>`0.5`: the default: hides keyword-only and unmatched entries<br>`0.7`: leading verbs, commit types and headings<br>`0.9`: headings, breaking markers and footers only | [`policy.min_confidence`](/reference/config#policy-min-confidence) |  |
| `--no-cache` | neither read nor write the HTTP cache | bool |  |  |  | not with `--offline`, `--refresh` |
| `--no-input` | never prompt for input; relgap has no prompts yet, so it has no effect | bool |  |  |  |  |
| `--offline` | answer from the HTTP cache only and fail on a miss | bool |  |  |  | not with `--refresh`, `--no-cache` |
| `-q, --quiet` | log errors only | bool |  |  |  | not with `--verbose` |
| `--refresh` | revalidate every cached response, even fresh ones | bool |  |  |  | not with `--offline`, `--no-cache` |
| `-v, --verbose` | more logging: -v info, -vv debug, -vvv trace | count |  |  |  | not with `--quiet` |

Each command page lists the `--format` values that command accepts.
